protocol.configuration: 100 random reference-body founders, 8–8–2 brains/90 neural parameters plus three linked body traits. 1000x600 arena; living cap300; actual 1/60s ticks. No synchronized cohorts or immigration.
protocol.births: Age>=15s, >=20s since prior attempt, energy>=.8 own capacity. Eligible-parent ordering uses a per-tick seeded lottery. Each child receives .4 of its own capacity; parent also pays .1 development and .05 overhead, retaining >=.25 of its own capacity. No energy charge on failed attempts, but cooldown applies. Failed energy/space proposals and cap blocks are retained. Newborns first act next tick; parents continue living.
protocol.mutation: Independent recorded brain/body seeds per parent and attempt. Neural probability.1/scale.1, body probability.25/log scale.08. Clonal controls set both probabilities to zero; all initial founders/layouts match within resource condition.
protocol.resource_model: Food carries20 energy. Finite regrowth rate and maximum standing food stock; unused growth credit is discarded at full stock. No creatures respawn after extinction. Sustenance is external renewable food input, not a closed energy system.
protocol.ancestry: Every unique birth ID, parent, founder family, depth, time, mutation attempt, failure, and genome is archived. Colors inherit founder family. Depth is ancestry depth, not synchronized generation.
protocol.diversity: Equal-weight neural/body blocks. Neural alleles standardized by initial distribution scales; body speed/range log-normalized to bounds and radius linearly normalized. RMS pairwise distance and within-family RMS; undefined without pairs. Connected components at distance.25 are operational snapshot clusters, with final sensitivity at.15/.5; bridge loss can split clusters and clusters are not species.
protocol.persistence: A run reaches its horizon with living actors, zero living founders, ancestry depth>=3 and births during the final120s; duration must be>=240s. This is finite-window population renewal, not proof of indefinite sustainability.
protocol.analysis: Eight independent source seeds; all four resource/mutation conditions included. Descriptive counts and equal-seed means, with explicit available denominators for diversity after extinction. No confirmatory p-values, selection-versus-drift claim, or post-result tuning.

analysis.interpretation: Descriptive repeated finite-window persistence, not proof of indefinite sustainability, adaptation over drift, reproductive isolation, or species formation. Clusters are threshold-dependent snapshot neighborhoods.
